verdict.rationale: Carta documents a real OAuth-secured API with cap table, stakeholder, option grant, convertible note and FMV endpoints, plus a few write paths (draft option grants, draft issuers) and an MCP plugin layer. However, the endpoints are versioned v1alpha1 and are overwhelmingly 'retrieve' operations scoped to specific partner use cases, so nothing shows UI parity. Missing for 10: evidence of write/administrative coverage matching the UI (issuing and finalizing securities, transfers, exercises, 409A ordering, account management), any stated API-parity commitment, a stable non-alpha API, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404).
